title: Lithium Battery Recycling
summary: The post Lithium Battery Recycling appeared first on Titan International, Inc. .
body_markdown: Lithium battery recycling is one of the new metallurgical challenges in our industry. As units pile up we are working to adapt Titan’s NiCo recovery circuits to yield significant benefits. For those attending the NAATBatt conference (Aug. 8th & 9th) and interested in learning more, we’ll be there too.
